title: Estimating Social Network Models with Link Misclassification
abstract: arXiv:2509.07343v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose an adjusted 2SLS estimator for social network models when reported binary network links are misclassified (some zeros reported as ones and vice versa) due, e.g., to survey respondents' recall errors, or lapses in data input. We show misclassification adds new sources of correlation between the regressors and errors, which makes all covariates endogenous and invalidates conventional estimators. We resolve these issues by constructing a novel estimator of misclassification rates and using those estimates to both adjust endogenous peer outcomes and construct new instruments for 2SLS estimation. A distinctive feature of our method is that it does not require structural modeling of link formation. Simulation results confirm our adjusted 2SLS estimator corrects the bias from a naive, unadjusted 2SLS estimator which ignores misclassification and uses conventional instruments. We apply our method to study peer effects in household

translated_title: 具有链接误分类的社会网络模型估计
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种调整后的2SLS（两阶段最小二乘）估计量，用于处理社会网络模型中报告的二元网络链接存在误分类的问题（部分零被报告为一，反之亦然），这种误分类可能源于调查受访者的记忆错误或数据录入疏忽。我们证明误分类会在回归变量与误差项之间引入新的相关性来源，使所有协变量都变为内生变量，并导致传统估计量失效。我们通过构建一种新颖的误分类率估计量来解决这些问题，并利用这些估计值来调整内生同伴结果，同时为2SLS估计构建新的工具变量。我们方法的一个独特特点是不需要对链接形成过程进行结构化建模。模拟结果证实，我们调整后的2SLS估计量能够纠正忽略误分类并使用传统工具变量的朴素未调整2SLS估计量所产生的偏差。我们将该方法应用于研究家庭同伴效应。
tldr: 提出一种调整后的2SLS估计量，通过构建误分类率估计量来纠正社会网络模型中链接误分类导致的偏差，且无需对链接形成进行结构化建模。
en_tdlr: Proposes an adjusted 2SLS estimator that corrects bias from link misclassification in social network models by constructing misclassification rate estimates, without requiring structural modeling of link formation.
